lanes.label: Version 2 · real-world setting
lanes.stem: A marine biologist calculates a 95% confidence interval for the mean weight of adult green sea turtles in a sanctuary. Using a sample of 100 turtles, she finds a standard deviation of 15 kg and a total interval width of 12 kg (with a margin of error of 6 kg). To improve precision, she increases her sample size to 400 turtles under identical environmental conditions. Assuming the sample standard deviation remains unchanged, what will be the width of the new 95% confidence interval?
